mapper.select: SELECT r.resume_no, r.username, r.resume_title, r.salary, l.like_code, GROUP_CONCAT(g.gubn_name) AS stack_codes, COUNT(s.stack_code) AS stack_count, (SELECT gubn_name FROM tbl_gubn WHERE group_code = 'education_code' AND gubn_code = MAX(e.resume_education_gbn_code)) AS educationName, (SELECT gubn_name FROM tbl_gubn WHERE group_code = 'career_code' AND gubn_code = r.career) AS career, f.file_url FROM tbl_resumes r LEFT JOIN tbl_resume_stack s ON s.resume_no = r.resume_no LEFT JOIN tbl_gubn g ON g.gubn_code = s.stack_code LEFT JOIN tbl_resume_education e ON e.resume_no = r.resume_no INNER JOIN tbl_likes l on l.like_id = r.resume_no AND l.username = #{username} AND l.like_code = 'S' LEFT JOIN tbl_file f ON f.file_gubn_code = 'profile_user' AND f.file_ref_no = r.username WHERE r.resume_pubilce_yn = 'Y' AND r.delete_yn = 'N' AND g.group_code IN (SELECT gubn_code FROM tbl_gubn WHERE group_code = 'stack_code') GROUP BY r.resume_no ORDER BY r.regist_dt DESC LIMIT 100;
